title: CineMem: Attention-Aligned Fine-grained Memory Retrieval for Multi-Shot Long Video Generation
title_zh: CineMem：面向多镜头长视频生成的注意力对齐细粒度记忆检索

paragraphs.en: Autoregressive video generation relies on memory retrieval to model long-range dependencies. This capability becomes particularly critical for multi-shot generation, where models must reconcile substantial visual changes across shot transitions with persistent semantic continuity. Existing methods tend to perform memory retrieval at the frame level and share the same historical context across all query tokens, overlooking the heterogeneous information needs and leading to redundant retrieval and inefficient use of historical memory. To bridge this gap, we introduce CineMem, an attention-aligned fine-grained memory retrieval framework that combines online memory organization with query-adaptive retrieval for autoregressive multi-shot video generation. Specifically, guided by intrinsic memory-access patterns revealed through attention analysis, we propose an online-clustered KV cache as a memory organization strategy over all historical tokens, enabling semantic-aware memory grouping and more precise retrieval. In addition, we introduce a query-level retrieval mechanism that provides broader access to historical information under a fixed retrieval budget, thereby improving long-term memory utilization. Together, these designs enable the multi-shot video generator to preserve long-range consistency across shot transitions, particularly in revisitation scenarios, while approximating full-memory access under a constrained memory budget. To facilitate evaluation, we further introduce a suite of task-specific, VLM-assisted metrics for faithful inter-shot consistency assessment. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework.

paragraphs.en: Building on bidirectional architectures and extensive pre-training, recent diffusion models ( Blattmann et al., 2023 ; Ho et al., 2020 ; Rombach et al., 2022 ; Song et al., 2020 ) deliver impressive visual quality, but at substantial computational cost for long-duration generation. Autoregressive generation offers a natural alternative for streaming video synthesis, typically combining a sliding-window mechanism with memory routing to maintain long-range consistency and stable generation ( Huang et al., 2026 ; Yin et al., 2025 ) . This capability is particularly important for multi-shot video generation ( Guo et al., 2025b ; Luo et al., 2026 ) , which aims to synthesize coherent, film-like narratives through frequent shot transitions accompanied by substantial viewpoint changes. Maintaining a continuous and coherent narrative flow across discrete shot boundaries naturally calls for a well-designed memory retrieval strategy, especially when previously observed subjects, scenes, or viewpoints reappear after intervening shots.

paragraphs.en: Existing memory mechanisms for causal video generation remain generally coarse-grained. Basic sliding-window strategies are widely adopted in single-shot causal models ( Huang et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2025 ) , inevitably discarding distant information as autoregressive rollout proceeds. In multi-shot scenarios, some methods preserve temporally predefined anchors as persistent memory ( Chen et al., 2026b ) , such as the first frames of individual shots. These designs follow fixed routing patterns determined by temporal structures rather than the model’s intrinsic memory-access patterns, limiting their ability to fully exploit historical information. More recent studies introduce retrieval-based memory strategies ( Meng et al., 2026a ; Luo et al., 2026 ) , which typically augment fixed sinks and adjacent context with frame-level routing. The resulting routing decision is shared across all query tokens. Although such designs allow content-aware access to historical cues, they still rely on coarse temporal grouping and overlook heterogeneous memory requirements across queries. Consequently, long-horizon autoregressive generation remains constrained by frame-level historical conditioning, leaving much of the available memory underutilized.
paragraphs.zh: 现有用于因果视频生成的记忆机制总体上仍较为粗略。 基本的滑动窗口策略被广泛应用于单次因果模型中（Huang et al., 2026; Yang et al., 2025），但随着自回归展开的推进，这些策略不可避免地会丢弃远处的信息。 在多次拍摄的场景中，一些方法会将预先定义的时间锚点作为持久记忆保留下来（Chen et al., 2026b），例如每段拍摄的首帧画面。 这些设计遵循由时间结构决定的固定路由模式，而非模型内在的记忆访问模式，从而限制其充分利用历史信息的能力。 近期的一些研究引入了基于检索的记忆策略（Meng et al., 2026a; Luo et al., 2026），这些策略通常通过帧级路由来增强固定的存储单元和相邻上下文。 由此产生的路由决策会被所有查询标记共享。 尽管这类设计允许根据内容访问历史线索，但它们仍然依赖粗略的时间分组，并忽略了不同查询之间异构的记忆需求。 因此，长时程的自回归生成仍受限于帧级的历史条件约束，导致大量可用记忆未被充分利用。

paragraphs.en: In this work, we explore how an autoregressive multi-shot video model can retrieve long-term historical information under a constrained memory budget by leveraging its intrinsic memory-access patterns. Rather than merely preserving adjacent-frame information for pixel-level continuity, memory in multi-shot scenarios should support the recovery of previously observed visual content after multiple shot transitions, a setting we refer to as revisitation. To this end, we propose CineMem, an attention-aligned fine-grained memory retrieval framework that combines online memory organization with query-adaptive retrieval for autoregressive multi-shot video generation. By adapting memory organization and retrieval granularity to attention-based selection patterns, CineMem enables more effective access to long-term history and improves long-range consistency across shot transitions, particularly in revisitation scenarios, as illustrated in Figure 1 .
paragraphs.zh: 在这项工作中，我们探讨了自回归多镜头视频模型如何利用其内在的记忆访问模式，在受限制的记忆预算下检索长期历史信息。 在多镜头场景中，记忆不应仅仅保留相邻帧的信息以确保像素级连续性，而应支持在多次镜头转换后恢复之前观察到的视觉内容，我们将这种设定称为“重访”。 为此，我们提出了 CineMem——一个与注意力机制对齐的细粒度记忆检索框架，它将在线记忆组织与查询自适应检索相结合，用于自回归多镜头视频生成。 通过将记忆组织和检索的粒度适配到基于注意力的选择模式，CineMem 实现了对长期历史信息的更有效访问，并提升了跨镜头转换的长程一致性，尤其是在重访场景中（如图 1 所示）。

paragraphs.en: To investigate the intrinsic memory-access patterns of autoregressive diffusion models, we first develop a training framework that converts a bidirectional video model into a long-duration autoregressive multi-shot generator operating in a chunk-by-chunk manner, while allowing each current chunk to attend to the full generation history. To stabilize long-horizon rollout, we further incorporate an error accumulation mitigation strategy during adaptation. We then analyze the attention distributions between query tokens in the current chunk and all historical memory tokens. We observe a clear clustering structure among historical memory tokens and substantial variation in retrieval preferences across query tokens and attention heads. These observations motivate our designs for online memory organization and query-adaptive retrieval.

paragraphs.en: Specifically, our framework comprises two complementary designs, as illustrated in Figure 2 . First, we apply online clustering to the KV cache to organize historical memory throughout autoregressive rollout. As generation proceeds, historical tokens are grouped according to their semantic similarity, with each cluster serving as a retrieval unit. In contrast to conventional frame-level schemes that partition tokens by fixed frame membership regardless of content, our design forms content-aware groups, which alleviates the redundancy introduced by retrieving entire frames, while avoiding the high computational cost of treating every historical token as an individual memory unit. Second, we introduce query-adaptive memory access in a query-wise and head-wise manner. Given their heterogeneous retrieval preferences, each query-head pair selects its most relevant clusters from memory. Under a fixed per-query memory budget, this individualized retrieval provides broader access to the generation history, yielding a larger effective attention receptive field without increasing the retrieval cost. Together, these designs better match intrinsic memory-access patterns while balancing retrieval granularity, historical coverage, and computational efficiency, enabling CineMem to maintain long-range consistency across frequent shot transitions.
paragraphs.zh: 具体来说，我们的框架包含两种互补的设计，如图 2 所示。 首先，我们对 KV 缓存应用在线聚类，在整个自回归生成过程中组织历史记忆。 随着生成过程推进，历史词元会根据其语义相似性进行分组，每个聚类都作为一个检索单元。 与传统的帧级方案不同——后者无论内容如何都按固定帧成员关系划分词元——我们的设计形成了内容感知的分组，这既减少了完整帧检索带来的冗余，也避免了将每个历史词元都视为独立记忆单元所带来的高昂计算成本。 其次，我们以查询为单位、以注意力头为单位，引入了可自适应查询的记忆访问机制。 鉴于各查询-注意力头对具有不同的检索偏好，每对查询-注意力头都会从记忆中挑选最相关的聚类。 在每轮查询的固定记忆预算下，这种个性化的检索方式能更广泛地访问生成历史，从而在不增加检索成本的前提下，获得更大的有效注意力感受野。 综合来看，这些设计更好地匹配了内在的记忆访问模式，同时平衡了检索粒度、历史覆盖范围与计算效率，使 CineMem 能够在频繁的场景切换中保持长程一致性。

sents.en: First, we apply online clustering to the KV cache to organize historical memory throughout autoregressive rollout.

sents.en: As generation proceeds, historical tokens are grouped according to their semantic similarity, with each cluster serving as a retrieval unit.
sents.zh: 随着生成过程推进，历史词元会根据其语义相似性进行分组，每个聚类都作为一个检索单元。

sents.en: In contrast to conventional frame-level schemes that partition tokens by fixed frame membership regardless of content, our design forms content-aware groups, which alleviates the redundancy introduced by retrieving entire frames, while avoiding the high computational cost of treating every historical token as an individual memory unit.
sents.zh: 与传统的帧级方案不同——后者无论内容如何都按固定帧成员关系划分词元——我们的设计形成了内容感知的分组，这既减少了完整帧检索带来的冗余，也避免了将每个历史词元都视为独立记忆单元所带来的高昂计算成本。

sents.en: Second, we introduce query-adaptive memory access in a query-wise and head-wise manner.
sents.zh: 其次，我们以查询为单位、以注意力头为单位，引入了可自适应查询的记忆访问机制。

sents.en: Given their heterogeneous retrieval preferences, each query-head pair selects its most relevant clusters from memory.
sents.zh: 鉴于各查询-注意力头对具有不同的检索偏好，每对查询-注意力头都会从记忆中挑选最相关的聚类。

sents.en: Under a fixed per-query memory budget, this individualized retrieval provides broader access to the generation history, yielding a larger effective attention receptive field without increasing the retrieval cost.
sents.zh: 在每轮查询的固定记忆预算下，这种个性化的检索方式能更广泛地访问生成历史，从而在不增加检索成本的前提下，获得更大的有效注意力感受野。

sents.en: Together, these designs better match intrinsic memory-access patterns while balancing retrieval granularity, historical coverage, and computational efficiency, enabling CineMem to maintain long-range consistency across frequent shot transitions.
sents.zh: 综合来看，这些设计更好地匹配了内在的记忆访问模式，同时平衡了检索粒度、历史覆盖范围与计算效率，使 CineMem 能够在频繁的场景切换中保持长程一致性。

paragraphs.en: For evaluation, we adopt a comprehensive protocol covering video-level quality, intra-shot consistency, and inter-shot consistency. Since conventional similarity-based metrics can assign deceptively high inter-shot consistency scores to videos that fail to perform the intended shot transition, we further introduce a VLM-assisted evaluation protocol that jointly considers transition execution and semantic preservation. This provides a more faithful assessment of inter-shot consistency in multi-shot generation. Experimental results show that CineMem achieves superior consistency compared with existing autoregressive baselines while remaining competitive with large-scale bidirectional models. Moreover, our attention-aligned retrieval designs are effective in a plug-in setting without additional fine-tuning, demonstrating their ability to better exploit historical information during autoregressive rollout. Overall, our work highlights the importance of fine-grained memory organization and retrieval for coherent long-horizon autoregressive multi-shot video generation.
paragraphs.zh: 在评估中，我们采用了一套全面的协议，涵盖视频级质量、单镜头内一致性和跨镜头一致性。 由于传统的基于相似性的指标可能会给未能实现预期镜头转换的视频赋予误导性的高跨镜头一致性分数，因此我们进一步引入了一种由 VLM 辅助的评估协议，该协议同时考虑了转换执行和语义保留。 这为多镜头生成中的跨镜头一致性提供了更真实的评估。 实验结果表明，与现有的自回归基线模型相比，CineMem 实现了更优的一致性，同时在与大规模双向模型的比较中仍具有竞争力。 此外，我们的注意力对齐检索设计在插件设置中无需额外微调即可有效运行，证明了其能够在自回归展开过程中更好地利用历史信息的能力。 总体而言，我们的工作凸显了精细的记忆组织与检索对于生成连贯的长时程自回归多镜头视频的重要性。

paragraphs.en: Autoregressive Video Generation and Memory. Diffusion-based autoregressive video generation enables streaming synthesis by progressively generating frames or chunks through autoregressive rollout ( Gao et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2026b ; Bruce et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2026a ; Guo et al., 2025a ) . Recent methods adapt pretrained bidirectional video models through post-training or distillation ( Zhu et al., 2026 ; Huang et al., 2026 ; Yin et al., 2025 ; Cui et al., 2026 ) , relying on fixed anchors, sliding windows, or coarse-grained memory retrieval to maintain long-range consistency ( Ji et al., 2025 ; Hu et al., 2026 ) . OminiMem ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) further introduces a fine-grained head-adaptive retrieval framework, but primarily focuses on single-shot video generation. Meanwhile, fine-grained KV-cache organization has been explored in LLMs ( Liu et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2026c ; Zhu et al., 2025 ) mainly for inference acceleration in the text domain. In contrast, our work investigates fine-grained retrieval over visual memory with the primary goal of preserving long-range consistency, which we study in the more demanding setting of autoregressive multi-shot video generation.

paragraphs.en: Multi-Shot Video Generation. Multi-shot video generation aims to synthesize sequences with discrete shot transitions while preserving narrative, subject, and scene consistency. Most existing approaches are built upon bidirectional video models and can be broadly categorized into two paradigms: generating individual shots separately and subsequently composing them ( He et al., 2023 ; Xie et al., 2024 ; Zheng et al., 2024 ; Long et al., 2024 ) , or directly modeling multi-shot sequences in an end-to-end manner ( Guo et al., 2025b ; Qi et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2026b ; Wu et al., 2026a ; Meng et al., 2026b ; Wang et al., 2026 ; Jia et al., 2026 ) . In autoregressive video generation, several methods enable dynamic content control by updating prompts during streaming synthesis, but primarily focus on single-shot generation ( Yang et al., 2025 ; Ji et al., 2025 ) . More recently, autoregressive approaches have begun to explore multi-shot generation. ShotStream ( Luo et al., 2026 ) reformulates the problem as next-shot generation, while CausalCine introduces content-aware memory routing for accessing historical information ( Meng et al., 2026a ) . Nevertheless, their memory retrieval remains relatively coarse-grained, limiting the effective use of long-term historical information.
paragraphs.zh: 多镜头视频生成。 多镜头视频生成旨在合成具有离散镜头转换的视频序列，同时保持叙事、主体和场景的一致性。 大多数现有方法都基于双向视频模型，并可大致分为两种范式：分别生成单个镜头再将其组合起来（He et al., 2023；Xie et al., 2024；Zheng et al., 2024；Long et al., 2024），或以端到端方式直接对多镜头序列进行建模（Guo et al., 2025b；Qi et al., 2025；Wu et al., 2026b；Wu et al., 2026a；Meng et al., 2026b；Wang et al., 2026；Jia et al., 2026）。 在自回归视频生成中，一些方法通过在流式合成过程中更新提示来实现动态内容控制，但主要关注单镜头生成（Yang et al., 2025；Ji et al., 2025）。 近期，自回归方法开始探索多镜头生成。 ShotStream（Luo et al., 2026）将该问题重新表述为下一镜头的生成，而 CausalCine 则引入了内容感知记忆路由以访问历史信息（Meng et al., 2026a）。 然而，它们的记忆检索仍然相对粗糙，限制了长期历史信息的有效利用。

paragraphs.en: Based on the full-memory model, we analyze memory-access patterns during autoregressive rollout to guide the design of a fine-grained retrieval mechanism that best matches the model’s intrinsic selection behavior under full-memory attention. While conventional retrieval schemes typically define the retrieval unit at the chunk-to-frame level, we revisit the fundamental token-to-token memory selection process inherent in attention, which motivates our fine-grained retrieval design. For each generated chunk, memory selection is essentially the process by which current tokens, serving as queries, select relevant historical memory tokens through their keys and values. For a query, highly attended keys receive higher attention probabilities, which mathematically correspond to larger normalized dot-product similarities. We therefore use this signal to study token-wise selection relationships and reveal the underlying memory-selection patterns.
paragraphs.zh: 基于全记忆模型，我们分析了自回归展开过程中的内存访问模式，以指导一种精细检索机制的设计，使其能最匹配全记忆注意力下模型内在的选择行为。 尽管传统的检索方案通常将检索单元定义在块到帧的层级上，但我们重新审视了注意力机制中固有的、从单个词元到单个词元的内存选择过程，这启发我们设计了精细的检索方案。 对于每个生成的块，内存选择本质上是一个过程：当前的词元作为查询，通过其键和值来选择相关的历史内存词元。 对于一个查询，受到高度关注的键会获得更高的注意力概率，这在数学上对应于更大的归一化点积相似度。 因此，我们利用这一信号来研究词元层面的选择关系，并揭示其底层的内存选择模式。

paragraphs.en: Memory structure. Efficient retrieval requires grouping, since treating each token as a separate group reduces retrieval to full-memory attention. Frame-level retrieval instead treats each frame as a group, implicitly assuming stronger correlations among tokens within the same frame. However, this assumption may not always hold, especially when a frame contains diverse content. To investigate this, we cluster the full-memory tokens and visualize the results in Figure 4(a) . Clear clustering patterns emerge: highly similar tokens tend to form cross-frame clusters, while tokens within each cluster exhibit semantic consistency to some extent. We also observe stronger correlations among tokens from the first frame than among those from other frames, consistent with prior findings on the importance of the first latent sink ( Chen et al., 2026a ) . These observations motivate grouping memory by token similarity rather than frame membership. This is because frame-based grouping may introduce redundant information, as retrieving a group due to a few highly relevant tokens also includes many weakly related ones. Moreover, using a single centroid to represent semantically diverse tokens from the same frames can weaken their semantics and reduce retrieval precision.
paragraphs.zh: 记忆结构。 高效的检索需要分组，因为将每个词元视为独立的一组会将检索简化为全记忆注意力机制。 帧级检索则将每一帧视为一个组，隐式地假设同一帧内的词元之间存在更强的相关性。 然而，这一假设可能并不总是成立，尤其是在某一帧包含多样化内容时。 为了研究这一问题，我们将全记忆中的词元进行聚类，并在图 4(a) 中展示了结果。 清晰的聚类模式显现出来：高度相似的词元倾向于形成跨帧的聚类，而每个聚类内部的词元在语义上表现出一定程度的一致性。 我们还观察到，第一帧中的词元之间的相关性比其他帧中的词元更强，这与关于首个潜在汇点重要性的先前研究结果一致（Chen et al., 2026a）。 这些观察结果促使我们根据词元的相似性而非帧归属来对记忆进行分组。 这是因为基于帧的分组可能会引入冗余信息，因为由于少数高度相关的词元而检索一个组时，也会包含许多相关性较弱的词元。 此外，使用单个中心点来表示来自同一帧但语义多样化的词元，可能会削弱它们的语义并降低检索精度。

paragraphs.en: To enable fine-grained memory grouping, we introduce an online cluster KV cache. During autoregressive rollout, memory tokens are dynamically grouped according to their cosine similarity, such that semantically related tokens are assigned to the same cluster. This design leverages the semantic coherence within each cluster: tokens relevant to the same query are likely to share similar semantic information, reducing redundant retrieval while improving retrieval effectiveness. To support fine-grained query-level retrieval, clustering is performed independently for each attention head. We retain the first and latest chunks as memory anchors. As rollout proceeds, expired adjacent chunks are progressively incorporated into retrieval candidates through online clustering. Specifically, newly introduced tokens are assigned to existing clusters based on centroid similarity, followed by cluster refinement. To maintain balanced and stable clusters during online updates, we introduce several balancing strategies. paragraphs.en: Considering the heterogeneous memory selection patterns discussed in Section 3.3 , we design a query-level retrieval mechanism, specifically query-wise and head-wise retrieval, for fine-grained memory access. Conventional retrieval shares a single historical memory subset across all queries, which cannot capture diverse query and head preferences, causing redundant retrieval of irrelevant tokens and missing relevant historical information. This motivates a more fine-grained retrieval unit. Instead of sharing, we allow each query-head pair to independently select relevant memory from the full history. Combined with the clustered KV cache in Section 3.4 , this design enables query-specific access to relevant memory clusters while maintaining the same retrieval budget, substantially expanding effective memory access and approximating full-memory attention under a constrained memory budget. paragraphs.en: Metrics. To comprehensively evaluate streaming multi-shot video generation, we construct an evaluation set of 100 prompts and establish an evaluation protocol covering video-level, intra-shot-level, and inter-shot-level metrics. Video-level metrics assess fundamental properties of generated videos, including visual aesthetics ( LAION-AI, 2022 ) , transition control ( Soucek and Lokoc, 2024 ) , and text alignment ( Wang et al., 2023 ) , while intra-shot metrics ( Oquab et al., 2024 ; Fu et al., 2023 ) evaluate consistency within individual shots. More importantly, inter-shot evaluation measures semantic consistency across shot transitions. However, existing similarity-based inter-shot metrics suffer from an inherent ambiguity: a high similarity score may indicate either strong transition consistency or simply the absence of a meaningful transition. Consequently, models with weak transition control may receive deceptively high consistency scores. To address this issue, we introduce a VLM-based metric ( Achiam et al., 2023 ) , the Prompt-conditioned Transition-Consistency Score (PTCS), as illustrated in Figure 6 . PTCS rewards transitions only when they are successfully executed while preserving the required semantic consistency. PTCS consists of two complementary components: Prompt-conditioned Continuity Preservation (PCP) and Prompt-conditioned Transition Alignment (PTA). Given a hierarchical prompt, we first construct a semantic state graph to identify the semantic elements that should remain unchanged and those expected to change across the transition. PCP measures whether the required elements are consistently preserved before and after the transition, whereas PTA evaluates whether the intended changes, such as modifications in focal subjects or camera configurations, are correctly realized. For each transition, PTCS is computed as the geometric mean of PCP and PTA and then averaged over the evaluation set. By jointly evaluating unchanged elements and intended changes, PTCS provides a more direct and faithful assessment of inter-shot consistency.
paragraphs.zh: 指标。 为了全面评估流式多镜头视频生成，我们构建了一个包含 100 个提示词的评价集，并制定了一套涵盖视频级、单镜头内和跨镜头指标的评价协议。 视频级指标用于评估生成视频的基本特性，包括视觉美学（LAION-AI, 2022）、过渡控制（Soucek and Lokoc, 2024）和文本对齐（Wang et al., 2023），而单镜头内指标（Oquab et al., 2024; Fu et al., 2023）则评估单个镜头内部的连贯性。 更重要的是，跨镜头评价用于衡量镜头转换之间的语义一致性。 然而，现有的基于相似性的跨镜头指标存在固有的模糊性：高相似度分数可能既表示过渡具有高度一致性，也可能仅仅表示没有发生有意义的过渡。 因此，过渡控制较弱的模型可能会获得误导性的高一致性分数。 为解决这一问题，我们引入了一种基于 VLM 的指标（Achiam et al., 2023），即提示条件化过渡一致性得分（PTCS），如图 6 所示。 PTCS 仅在过渡成功执行且保留了所需的语义一致性时才会给予奖励。 PTCS 由两个互补的组成部分构成：提示条件化连贯性保持（PCP）和提示条件化过渡对齐（PTA）。 给定一个分层提示，我们首先构建一个语义状态图，以识别在过渡过程中应保持不变的语义元素以及预期发生变化的元素。 PCP 衡量所需元素在过渡前后是否得到一致保留，而 PTA 则评估预期的变化（例如焦点主体或相机配置的修改）是否正确实现。 对于每个过渡，PTCS 的计算方式是 PCP 和 PTA 的几何平均值，然后对评价集进行平均。 通过联合评估保持不变的元素和预期变化的内容，PTCS 能够更直接、更准确地衡量跨镜头一致性。

paragraphs.en: Qualitative Results. Figure 5 presents visual comparisons between CineMem and representative causal and bidirectional baselines. Causal multi-prompt models ( Yesiltepe et al., 2026 ; Ji et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2026 ) , despite using varying prompts to enrich the generated content, often struggle to produce explicit shot transitions under multi-shot conditioning and may introduce visual artifacts. Among causal multi-shot baselines, LongLive2 ( Chen et al., 2026b ) still exhibits limited transition control, while ShotStream ( Luo et al., 2026 ) tends to lose consistency as the number of shots increases. Notably, we do not include CausalCine ( Meng et al., 2026a ) in the comparison since its model weights are not publicly available. Instead, we implement a comparable frame-grouping strategy with shared retrieval, which is further analyzed in our ablation study. Strong bidirectional baselines ( Wang et al., 2026 ; Meng et al., 2026b ) also occasionally suffer from cross-shot inconsistency or incorrect shot counts. In contrast, CineMem generates stable multi-shot videos in an autoregressive setting while faithfully following the prescribed transitions and maintaining cross-shot consistency, including challenging revisitation scenarios.

paragraphs.en: Quantitative Results. Table 2 reports the quantitative comparison on our evaluation set. CineMem achieves strong performance across video-level quality and intra-shot consistency metrics, demonstrating its ability to generate high-quality videos while maintaining stable shot-level content. For inter-shot evaluation, CineMem achieves the best performance on PTCS, which jointly considers unchanged elements and intended changes during shot transitions. Notably, models with high similarity-based inter-shot scores or PCP values often exhibit limited transition control, while models specifically designed for multi-shot generation may still receive relatively low scores on these metrics. This indicates that similarity-based or preservation-only metrics can overestimate inter-shot consistency when the intended transition is not properly realized. By explicitly considering both preserved and changing elements specified in the prompt, PTCS provides a more faithful evaluation of transition quality. Finally, CineMem achieves superior PTCS performance and even surpasses larger bidirectional models with substantially more parameters.
paragraphs.zh: 定量结果。 表 2 报告了我们在评估集上的定量对比结果。 CineMem 在视频级质量指标和单镜头内一致性指标上均表现出强劲性能，证明了其能够在保持镜头内容稳定的同时生成高质量视频的能力。 在跨镜头评估中，CineMem 在 PTCS 上取得了最佳性能，该指标综合考量了镜头转换过程中未改变的元素和预期变化。 值得注意的是，基于高相似性得分或 PCP 值的模型往往表现出有限的转换控制能力，而专为多镜头生成设计的模型在这些指标上仍可能获得相对较低的分数。 这表明，当预期的转换未被正确实现时，基于相似性或仅关注保留元素的指标可能会高估跨镜头一致性。 通过明确考虑提示词中指定的保留元素和变化元素，PTCS 能够更真实地评估转换质量。 最后，CineMem 在 PTCS 上取得了卓越性能，甚至超越了参数数量远多于它的更大规模双向模型。

paragraphs.en: Retrieval Strategy. We analyze different retrieval strategies introduced in Sections 3.4 and 3.5 under a plug-in setting. Specifically, we compare our clustered KV cache and query-wise retrieval with frame-level grouping and shared retrieval. To isolate the effect of retrieval design, we directly apply different strategies to the adapted base model without additional training. As shown, query-wise retrieval consistently improves performance under both frame-level and clustered memory organization, demonstrating the importance of fine-grained memory access. Moreover, clustered KV cache further improves transition quality and inter-shot consistency over frame-level grouping, validating the effectiveness of semantic-based memory organization. Notably, without additional training, our retrieval strategy achieves comparable performance to full-memory attention while obtaining higher inter-shot consistency, demonstrating its effectiveness under a constrained memory budget.

paragraphs.en: Query-level Retrieval Variant. We investigate a query grouping variant of our retrieval mechanism. Instead of performing independent retrieval for each query, this variant recursively partitions queries into groups according to their spatial and semantic similarity using an adaptive tree structure and shares retrieved memory within each group. Although query grouping provides an effective approximation by exploiting query similarity, it remains slightly inferior to fully query-wise retrieval, further validating the importance of fine-grained query retrieval.

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we introduce CineMem, a fine-grained memory retrieval framework for autoregressive multi-shot video generation. Combining an online clustered KV cache with query-adaptive retrieval, CineMem enables broader historical access and improves long-range consistency in revisitation scenarios. We develop an autoregressive adaptation framework with resampled context to analyze intrinsic memory-access patterns, revealing semantic clustering among memory tokens and heterogeneous query-head preferences that motivate our design. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework. Our results highlight the importance of fine-grained memory modeling for autoregressive video generation. Rather than relying only on recent frames, autoregressive models should exploit information throughout history. Advances in memory organization and retrieval will enable scalable long-horizon video generation.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们介绍了 CineMem——一个用于自回归多帧视频生成的细粒度记忆检索框架。 通过将在线聚类 KV 缓存与查询自适应检索相结合，CineMem 实现了更广泛的历史信息访问，并提升了重访场景中的长程一致性。 我们开发了一个带有重采样上下文的自回归自适应框架，用以分析内在的记忆访问模式，揭示了记忆令牌之间的语义聚类以及异构查询头的偏好，这些发现也启发我们设计了当前方案。 大量实验证明了该框架的有效性。 我们的研究结果凸显了细粒度记忆建模对于自回归视频生成的重要性。 自回归模型不应仅依赖近期帧，而应充分利用历史中的全部信息。 记忆组织与检索技术的进步将推动可扩展的长时程视频生成。

paragraphs.en: In Figure 4(b) , we provide an overall visualization of the heterogeneous memory selection behaviors across queries and attention heads. Specifically, each frame is divided into 2 × 2 2\times 2 spatial regions, resulting in four memory units per frame. paragraphs.en: Although the differences among highlighted regions across rows in Figure 4(b) already reveal the existence of heterogeneous memory selection over the entire history sequence, the diversity of query preferences is also manifested within individual memory frames. However, the 2 × 2 2\times 2 spatial partition provides only a coarse characterization of such intra-frame variations. paragraphs.en: In Section 3.4 , we introduce an online clustering mechanism to organize memory tokens into semantic groups rather than predefined frame-based partitions. In practice, before entering each transformer block, token representations are augmented with positional encoding. Our clustering and retrieval operations are therefore performed before RoPE (Pre-RoPE). This design choice is motivated by the observation that positional encoding introduces strong absolute position information into token representations, which can obscure semantic similarity and weaken semantic clustering structures.
paragraphs.zh: 在第 3.4 节中，我们引入了一种在线聚类机制，将记忆标记组织为语义组，而非预定义的基于框架的分区。 实际上，在进入每个 transformer 块之前，标记表示会附加位置编码。 因此，我们的聚类和检索操作在 RoPE（Pre-RoPE）之前执行。 这一设计选择的动机在于：位置编码为标记表示引入了强烈的绝对位置信息，这可能会掩盖语义相似性并削弱语义聚类结构。

paragraphs.en: In fact, the visualization in Figure 4(a) is obtained using token representations before positional encoding. To further investigate this effect, Figure 10 presents representative clustering results before and after applying RoPE. We observe that RoPE-transformed tokens exhibit stronger position-dependent similarity patterns, while the semantic grouping structure becomes less apparent. Therefore, performing clustering and retrieval after positional encoding may bias memory organization toward positional grouping and degrade into a behavior similar to frame-level partitioning, limiting the benefits of semantic-aware memory organization. These observations support our choice of conducting clustering and retrieval in the Pre-RoPE space.

paragraphs.en: Our retrieval mechanism aims to approximate the memory access pattern of full-memory attention under a constrained retrieval budget. To further evaluate this property, we analyze retrieval alignment from the perspective of full-memory attention. Specifically, we treat full-memory attention as an oracle: for each query-head pair, memory tokens are ranked according to their attention scores, and highly attended tokens are regarded as the oracle retrieval targets.

paragraphs.en: As shown in Figure 11 , CineMem achieves consistently higher precision than frame-level grouping and sliding-window retrieval across almost the entire threshold range. It also achieves higher recall in the low-to-moderate threshold regime, indicating that it can recover a larger fraction of highly relevant memory tokens while introducing fewer irrelevant tokens. At very high thresholds, the recall of the online-clustered KV cache becomes slightly lower than fixed-budget baselines. This behavior does not indicate inferior retrieval quality. When x = 100 % x=100\% , the oracle set contains all memory tokens, and recall mainly reflects the proportion of memory tokens retrieved. Fixed-budget baselines always retrieve a predetermined number of tokens, whereas the online-clustered KV cache adaptively retrieves a compact set of relevant clusters. Therefore, the reduced recall at large x x reflects a smaller and less redundant retrieval set rather than a failure to identify important memory information.

paragraphs.en: In this section, we analyze the efficiency of CineMem and compare it with two representative memory access strategies. Full-history attention is considered as an upper bound in terms of memory availability, as it provides access to the complete historical context without retrieval constraints. Meanwhile, frame-group retrieval serves as an efficient coarse-grained baseline by selecting a fixed number of historical frames with shared routing. In contrast, CineMem performs fine-grained query-head-wise retrieval over online-clustered memory, aiming to achieve a better balance between retrieval granularity and computational cost. We evaluate these strategies from both theoretical and practical perspectives. The theoretical analysis focuses on self-attention computation and retrieval overhead, while the practical evaluation measures actual inference efficiency.

The reported FLOPs include self-attention and retrieval-related computation, while the collected K/V volume denotes the logical amount of retrieved memory elements. The theoretical comparison shows that both retrieval strategies substantially reduce the self-attention cost compared with full-history attention. paragraphs.en: We further evaluate the practical inference efficiency of different memory strategies. We measure both the per-chunk denoising time and peak GPU memory usage during a 42-chunk autoregressive rollout. All measurements are conducted on four H200 GPUs with sequence parallelism ( s ​ p ​ _ ​ s ​ i ​ z ​ e = 4 sp\_size=4 ). As shown in Figure 12 , retrieval-based methods exhibit much more stable inference time compared with full-history attention. Although full-history attention achieves lower latency at the beginning of generation, its denoising time increases continuously as more historical tokens participate in attention computation. In contrast, both frame-group retrieval and CineMem maintain relatively stable latency by constraining the amount of historical memory retrieved. CineMem introduces a small additional overhead compared with frame-group retrieval due to online clustering and query-adaptive routing, but the difference remains limited throughout the rollout. For peak memory consumption, CineMem and frame-group retrieval exhibit nearly identical memory growth, as shown in Figure 12 . Although CineMem maintains additional cluster metadata, the overall memory usage is dominated by KV cache storage. Consequently, the extra memory required by cluster statistics and routing information is marginal, resulting in comparable memory footprints between the two retrieval strategies. These results demonstrate that CineMem achieves fine-grained and adaptive memory retrieval without introducing substantial practical efficiency overhead.

paragraphs.zh: 在视频级评估中，我们关注生成视频的基本特性，包括视觉质量、文本与视频的对应关系以及过渡的可控性。 我们采用了这些方面广泛使用的评估工具，包括 LAION 美学评分（LAION-AI, 2022）、基于 ViCLIP 的相似性度量（Wang et al., 2023）以及基于 TransNetV2 的过渡评估（Soucek and Lokoc, 2024）。

paragraphs.en: For inter-shot-level evaluation, we first adopt a conventional similarity-based metric commonly used in multi-shot video generation ( Wang et al., 2023 ) . Similar to intra-shot evaluation, this metric measures feature similarity between frames from different shots. In addition, we introduce a VLM-assisted metric, Prompt-conditioned Transition-Consistency Score (PTCS), which consists of two complementary components: Prompt-conditioned Continuity Preservation (PCP) and Prompt-conditioned Transition Alignment (PTA). Given a hierarchical prompt, we first construct a semantic state graph to identify the semantic elements that should remain unchanged and those expected to change across each transition. PCP evaluates whether the required elements are consistently preserved before and after the transition, while PTA measures whether the intended changes, such as modifications in focal subjects or camera configurations, are correctly realized.

paragraphs.en: As discussed in Section 4.2 , conventional similarity-based inter-shot consistency metrics evaluate transitions by measuring feature similarity between frames from different shots. However, such metrics inherently favor cases where adjacent shots exhibit limited visual changes, assigning high consistency scores even when the intended transition is not successfully realized. This limitation explains why some methods can achieve high inter-shot consistency scores while exhibiting poor transition control. These observations motivate our design of PTCS, which explicitly considers both semantic preservation and prompt-specified transition changes. Given that PTCS serves as a key metric for evaluating the effectiveness of CineMem, we further analyze its validity in this section.
paragraphs.zh: 如第 4.2 节所述，传统的基于相似性的跨镜头一致性指标通过测量不同镜头中帧之间的特征相似度来评估镜头转换。 然而，这类指标本质上更倾向于相邻镜头间视觉变化有限的情况，即使预期的转换未能成功实现，它们仍会给出较高的一致性分数。 这一局限性解释了为何某些方法能够获得较高的跨镜头一致性分数，却在转换控制方面表现不佳。 这些观察结果促使我们设计了 PTCS，该指标明确考虑了语义保留和提示指定的转换变化两个方面。 鉴于 PTCS 是评估 CineMem 有效性的关键指标，我们将在本节进一步分析其有效性。

paragraphs.en: We visualize several multi-shot examples with PTCS evaluations in Figure 13 . Qualitatively, PCP successfully reflects transitions where semantic consistency is violated, while PTA captures both missing transitions, where the intended shot change is not realized, and unexpected changes introduced during transitions, including inconsistencies in style, character identity, spatial relationships, or even subtle local details. By jointly considering these two complementary aspects, PTCS provides scores that better align with the desired properties of shot transitions. In contrast, similarity-based inter-shot consistency metrics may produce misleading evaluations: when the visual composition remains similar, they can assign high scores despite missing or incorrect transitions, while failing to distinguish valid and invalid transitions under substantial compositional changes.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在图 13 中展示了多个多轮示例及其 PTCS 评估结果。 从定性角度来看，PCP 能够成功反映语义一致性被破坏的过渡场景；而 PTA 则能同时捕捉到缺失的过渡（即预期的镜头切换未实现）以及过渡过程中引入的意外变化，包括风格、角色身份、空间关系甚至细微局部细节方面的一致性缺失。 通过联合考虑这两个互补的方面，PTCS 提供的评分能够更好地与镜头过渡所期望的特性保持一致。 相比之下，基于相似性的镜头间一致性指标可能会产生误导性评估：当视觉构图保持相似时，即使存在缺失或不正确的过渡，它们仍可能给出高分；而在构图发生显著变化时，它们又无法区分有效与无效的过渡。

paragraphs.en: To complement the quantitative evaluation, we conduct a user study to investigate whether PTCS aligns with human perception of inter-shot consistency. Specifically, we select 30 prompts for evaluation, and participants rate each generated video on a scale from 1 to 5 from three perspectives: overall video quality, intra-shot consistency, and inter-shot consistency. The mean opinion scores (MOS) are summarized in Table 4 . As shown, the human evaluation results are consistent with the trends observed in PTCS. Methods with higher PTCS scores generally receive higher inter-shot consistency ratings from human participants, while models that achieve high similarity-based consistency scores but fail to perform the intended transitions receive substantially lower human scores. This agreement indicates that PTCS better captures human-perceived transition consistency by jointly considering semantic preservation and prompt-specified changes. Furthermore, CineMem achieves the highest MOS in inter-shot consistency and competitive overall video quality, demonstrating its ability to generate coherent multi-shot videos with controllable transitions.

paragraphs.en: Limitations. Due to limited computational resources, our experiments are conducted on a relatively small-scale autoregressive backbone with a limited amount of training data for adapting a bidirectional model into a long-horizon autoregressive generator. Consequently, the visual quality of generated videos may lag behind that of large-scale state-of-the-art diffusion models with substantially larger model capacity and training data. Nevertheless, our experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed memory retrieval framework and reveal meaningful insights into memory utilization in autoregressive diffusion models. We expect that the proposed approach can further benefit from larger-scale models and datasets.

paragraphs.en: Failure Cases. Our memory retrieval mechanism aims to approximate the intrinsic full-memory access pattern under a constrained memory budget by enabling more effective historical information retrieval. However, it still struggles in scenarios requiring complex multi-entity reasoning, as illustrated in Figure 18 . In the presented example, the generated video exhibits issues such as missing characters and inconsistent details across shot transitions. Such failures are particularly challenging for autoregressive generation. In this case, an early chunk introduces four characters through its prompt, while a later chunk requires only three characters. The model must therefore generate a valid transition by adjusting the camera viewpoint while preserving the spatial relationships and identities established in previous shots. However, the earlier chunks are generated without knowledge of future shot requirements, making such coordinated transitions inherently difficult, especially when the initial composition does not provide sufficient flexibility. Therefore, multi-entity scenarios with complex shot transitions remain challenging even for full-memory autoregressive generation or bidirectional models, as they require reasoning beyond historical information retrieval. While our proposed memory mechanism improves access to relevant historical content and achieves promising results on certain multi-entity scenarios (see supplementary project page), handling complex entity interactions remains an important direction for future work.
paragraphs.zh: 失败案例。 我们的记忆检索机制旨在通过更有效地检索历史信息，在受限的记忆预算下近似实现内在的全记忆访问模式。 然而，在需要复杂多实体推理的场景中，该机制仍存在困难，如图 18 所示。 在所给出的示例中，生成的视频出现了角色缺失以及不同镜头切换时细节不一致等问题。 此类失败对于自回归生成而言尤其具有挑战性。 在此案例中，早期的片段通过其提示引入了四个角色，而后续的片段仅需三个角色。 因此，模型必须通过调整摄像机视角来生成有效的过渡，同时保持先前镜头中已确立的空间关系和身份特征。 然而，早期片段是在不了解未来镜头需求的情况下生成的，这使得此类协调一致的过渡本质上难以实现，尤其是在初始构图未能提供足够灵活性的情况下。 因此，即使对于全记忆自回归生成或双向模型而言，包含复杂镜头切换的多实体场景仍然具有挑战性，因为它们需要超越历史信息检索的推理能力。 尽管我们提出的记忆机制改善了对相关历史内容的访问，并在某些多实体场景中取得了令人鼓舞的结果（参见补充项目页面），但处理复杂的实体交互仍然是未来工作的重要方向。

paragraphs.en: Beyond the proposed online clustered KV cache and query-adaptive retrieval framework, several directions remain open for future exploration. For memory organization, more effective clustering strategies could further improve retrieval quality. Meanwhile, exploiting the shared retrieval patterns among queries may provide more efficient alternatives to fully query-wise and head-wise retrieval, as explored by the query-group variant in Section 4.3 . These directions may enable more scalable and efficient memory mechanisms for autoregressive video generation.
paragraphs.zh: 除了本文提出的在线聚类 KV 缓存和查询自适应检索框架之外，未来仍有多个方向值得进一步探索。 在内存组织方面，采用更有效的聚类策略可能进一步提升检索质量。 同时，利用查询之间的共享检索模式，或许能为完全按查询或按头进行检索提供更高效率的替代方案，正如第 4.3 节中查询分组变体所探索的那样。 这些方向可能有助于实现更具扩展性和效率的内存机制，以支持自回归视频生成。
